title: The Creative use for the old wood
subtitle: 艺术殿堂 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 艺术殿堂（文学艺术与体育·绘画、建筑等领域的代表作品和人物）
meta: 主题语境：艺术殿堂（文学艺术与体育·绘画、建筑等领域的代表作品和人物）　|　核心词汇：creative　|　正文 345 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 creative 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1979 the counsellor wrote of ① a creative use for the old wood in the journal, and everybody in the garden said at once that it was ② more creative than the one named there the year before. Three evenings on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the counsellor, who never explained anything, had done it on the same day and gone home; it was the creative ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the most creative use for the old wood anybody in the garden had ever seen, or so the journal for June 1973 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too creative to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the listener who had come to help; the creative ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the letter at the far bench, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a creative mind in the workshop, and said that no listener in his right mind would call it ⑥ as creative as the mind in the workshop they had once had in the old garden. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was creative or not, and he said so.

By 1986 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the journal. What the line asked for was ⑦ something creative, and nothing besides. The listener from the next garden called the whole plan ⑧ quite creative; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the journal kept the names of the creative ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1989, before dawn, she wrote of another creative use for the old wood in the same journal, and the work, which took two evenings, seemed ⑨ more creative than anybody had expected. ⑩ The most creative mind in the workshop in the whole garden, she said in 1991, was the one she could never quite name; the creative ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 有创造力（前置定语 a creative use for the old wood：1979 年谈心人在心记里记下的那件有创造力的用法）
B. adj. 有创造力／别出心裁（比较级 more creative than：文中两处，一处比旧木料的用法，一处比预想）
C. adj. 有创造力／别出心裁（最高级 the most creative：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 有创造力（表语 too creative to do：母亲觉得它太有创造力，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 别出心裁（前置定语 a creative mind in the workshop：叔叔把整件事称作一桩别出心裁的巧思）
F. adj. 别出心裁（同级比较 as creative as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩作坊里的巧思相比）
G. adj. 别出心裁（后置定语 something creative：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 别出心裁（受程度副词修饰 quite creative：那位倾听者的评价）

items.q: a creative use for the old wood
the most creative use for the old wood anybody
a creative mind in the workshop
The most creative mind in the workshop in

answers.why: creative 意为“有创造力”，1979 年谈心人在心记里记下的是“一件有创造力的用法”，此处作前置定语 a creative use for the old wood。
creative 意为“有创造力”，此处用比较级 more creative than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
creative 意为“有创造力”，心记上 六月 那行字说它是小园里最有创造力的一件，故用最高级 the most creative use for the old wood。
creative 意为“有创造力”，母亲认为这件东西“太有创造力了，谁也用不上”，too creative to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
creative 意为“别出心裁”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩别出心裁的巧思”，此处作前置定语 a creative mind in the workshop。
creative 意为“别出心裁”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩作坊里的巧思一样别出心裁”，同级比较用 as creative as。
creative 意为“别出心裁”，心记上那半行字要的是“别出心裁的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something creative。
creative 意为“别出心裁”，邻小园来的那位倾听者认为这套计划“相当别出心裁”，quite 修饰原级 creative。
creative 意为“别出心裁”，1989 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要别出心裁”，故用比较级 more creative than。
creative 意为“别出心裁”，母亲 1991 年说的是“整个小园里最别出心裁的那一桩”，故用最高级 the most creative mind in the workshop。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1979 年，谈心人在心记里记下了一件有创造力的用法。（a creative use for the old wood）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更有创造力。（more creative than …）
母亲觉得它太有创造力，谁也用不上。（too creative to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩别出心裁的巧思。（a creative mind in the workshop）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩作坊里的巧思一样别出心裁。（as creative as …）
到了 1986 年，心记上只剩半行字：要的是一件别出心裁的东西。（something creative）
answers: In 1979 the counsellor wrote of a creative use for the old wood in the journal.
Everybody said it was more creative than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too creative to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a creative mind in the workshop.
He said nobody would call it as creative as the mind in the workshop they had once had.
By 1986 the journal asked for nothing but something creative.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 creative 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1979 the counsellor wrote of a creative use for the old wood in the journal, and nobody forgot it.
It was the most creative use for the old wood in the garden, or so the journal says.
My mother thought it too creative to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a creative mind in the workshop, and nobody argued with him.
The listener from the next garden called the plan quite creative, and everybody laughed.
The creative ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
